g.text: MQ-6 and MQ-7 gas sensors with integrated heaters.

text.tspan: Power supply network according to STM32G4 reference design.
Each VDD pin decoupled with 100nF capacitor.

g.text: Driven by STM32 using PWM signal

text.tspan: Multiple GND pins are distributed across the connector to:
- Provide solid reference for all signals
- Reduce noise and improve signal integrity

g.text: Max current of the PCB: less than 400mA

text.tspan: Series resistor used to isolate multiple reset sources.
High-side switch for NRF power control.

g.c_para: package`SOT-23-5_L3.0-W1.7-P0.95-LS2.8-BR`Supplier`LCSC`Manufacturer`ST(意法半导体)`Manufacturer Part`STWD100NYWY3F`Supplier Part`C46043`JLCPCB Part Class`Extended Part`spicePre`U`spiceSymbolName`STWD100NYWY3F`

text.tspan: Multiple GND pins are distributed across the connector to:
- Provide solid reference for all signals
- Reduce noise and improve signal integrity

g.text: Note: C34 and C32 are not mounted by default. These values are used for corrections
ANTON - not used keep it N/C
WAKEUP - not used keep it N/C
VDD_REF - external active antenna (not used) keep it N/C
Note: R49 and R50 are placed only as footprints (in case of weird behaviors with not used I2C)

text.tspan: 2.4 - 2.525 GHz matching network based on nRF24L01+ reference design.
Values may require tuning depending on PCB stackup and antenna.

g.text: IRQ is active LOW, pulled-up externally

text.tspan: NRF_VC is switched by P-MOSFET to allow
Used for recovery from RF lockups.
- Communication with external devices (SPI, UART, I2C)
- Delegating real-time motor and servo control to XMC4200
- SWDIO, SWCLK for programming and debugging
VDDA filtered separately for analog domain.
SPI interfaces used for external peripherals:
Series resistors used for signal integrity.
- Currently configured as GPIO (USART3), pulled low to ensure boot from Flash.
Power supply network according to XMC4200 reference design.
Each VDDP pin decoupled with 100nF capacitor.
- Control of DC motors and servo mechanisms
- PWM generation using CCU4 and CCU8 timers
Series resistor used for signal integrity.
- TMS, TCK for programming and debugging

g.text: HOLD and Write Protection (WP) not used
Max current draw at 3.3V - less than 1mA

text.tspan: Sensor outputs form analog voltage dividers referenced to +3.3V.
Output signals (MQ6_IN, MQ7_IN) are read by STM32 ADC.
No additional current limiting required (within specification after preheating).

g.text: SWO/TDO → UART TX, NC/TDI → UART RX.
